Salla's customers: its Customers, All customers and Customer settings links, its dashboard app @salla.sa/ui-merchant-customers, its Merchant API folder Customers and customers scope, its customer.created and customer.updated events, its customer staff permissions, plan lines and flags (SA-S-1693, SA-S-1032, SA-S-1546). Shopify's Segments: its route in the Customers section (SH-S-7090), the customerSegmentation entitlement, the plan line Create customer segments, the segment webhook topics and the customer segment template extension.

Shopify's customers' marketing consent: its Edit marketing status route in the Customers section (SH-S-7093), the API's customerEmailMarketingSubscribe and customerWhatsAppMarketingConsentUpdate, and its consent webhook topics. Salla's customer addresses: its Shipping addresses settings route among the customers settings (SA-S-1717) and its national address setting and flags. Its Geolocation app category and map service flags are cited in CM-CUS-009, a child in this tree. Its order.shipping.address.updated event (SA-S-1574) is the order's address and isn't cited. Shopify has no concern for addresses; its cell cites inventory entries Q1 placed in SH-C-039 and SH-C-041, so the join is single.

Q1's M-018 holds SH-C-041 with SA-C-060 as a difference of grain; U-017 asks about this join and is ruled joined here.
